format: Neo Destiny (N4, 2002): cards not already in the pool. Unlimited only. Lucky Stadium 100 is the Wizards promo (WP 41), Shining Celebi 106 the 30th Celebration Classic Collection card (30C CC6).

abilities.name: Conductivity
abilities.text: Whenever your opponent attaches an Energy card from their hand to a Pokémon, this power does 10 damage to that Pokémon (no Weakness or Resistance). It stops working if you have more than 1 Dark Ampharos in play, or while this Pokémon is Asleep, Confused or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Shock Bolt
attacks.text: Discard all Lightning Energy cards attached to this Pokémon or this attack does nothing.

abilities.name: Surprise Bite
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand, you may choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This power does 20 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance.)

attacks.name: Dark Drain
attacks.text: Flip a coin for each of your opponent's Pokémon. For each heads, this attack does 10 damage to that Pokémon. Don't apply Weakness and Resistance. Remove a number of damage counters from this Pokémon equal to the damage dealt. If this Pokémon has fewer damage counters than that, remove all of them.

attacks.name: Tusk Toss
attacks.text: If your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, flip a coin. If heads, return the Defending Pokémon and all cards attached to it to your opponent's hand. If tails, your opponent chooses 1 of their Benched Pokémon and switches it with the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Gouge
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 10 more damage; if tails, this attack does 10 damage.

attacks.name: Psysplash
attacks.text: Does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon for each Energy card attached to that Pokémon. Don't apply Weakness and Resistance.

abilities.name: Scare
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon, all of your opponent's Baby Pokémon Powers stop working and your opponent's Baby Pokémon can't attack. It stops working while this Pokémon is Asleep, Confused or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Crushing Blow
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon has any Energy cards attached to it, flip a coin. If heads, choose 1 of those cards and discard it.

abilities.name: Deep Sleep
abilities.text: As long as any Dark Gengar is in play, a player flips 2 coins for each of their Pokémon that is Asleep at the end of each turn; if either is tails, that Pokémon is still Asleep. It stops working while this Pokémon is Asleep, Confused or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Pull In
attacks.text: If your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, you may choose 1 of them and switch it with the Defending Pokémon (before doing damage or other effects of this attack). Either way, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Eerie Howl
attacks.text: If your opponent's Bench isn't full, look at their hand. If your opponent has any Baby Pokémon or Basic Pokémon there, choose 1 of them and put it on their Bench. Then, switch it with the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Dark Fire
attacks.text: If there are any Darkness Energy cards attached to this Pokémon (basic or Special: your ruling), discard 1 of them and this attack does 30 damage plus 20 more damage (plus 10 more damage for the Darkness Energy you discarded). If there aren't any, this attack does 30 damage.

abilities.name: Spatial Distortion
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may flip a coin. If heads, choose a Stadium card from your discard pile and put it into play. (If there's already a Stadium card in play, discard it.) Not while this Pokémon is Asleep, Confused or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Curve Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all damage done by attacks to this Pokémon during your opponent's next turn. (Any other effects of attacks still happen.)

attacks.name: Threaten
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, look at your opponent's hand. If they have any Trainer cards there, choose 1 of them. Your opponent shuffles that card into their deck.

attacks.name: Rushing Flames
attacks.text: You may discard any number of Fire Energy cards attached to your Pokémon. Flip a coin for each Fire Energy card discarded in this way. This attack does 40 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Mountain Smasher
attacks.text: Flip a number of coins equal to the number of Fighting Energy cards attached to this Pokémon. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads. Then, for each heads, discard the top card from your opponent's deck.

attacks.name: Fling Away
attacks.text: If your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, this attack does 30 damage instead of 50 and choose 1 of those Benched Pokémon. This attack does 30 damage to that Pokémon. (No Weakness or Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

abilities.name: Drive Off
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon, once during your turn (before your attack), if your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, they choose 1 of them and switch it with the Defending Pokémon. This power can't be used while this Pokémon is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Gentle Flames
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon is a Baby Pokémon, this attack does 10 damage instead of 50. If the Defending Pokémon is a Basic Pokémon, this attack does 30 damage instead of 50.

attacks.name: Bubble
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Bubble Jump
attacks.text: If you have any Benched Pokémon, flip a coin. If heads, take 2 Energy cards attached to this Pokémon and attach them to 1 of your Benched Pokémon. Then return this Pokémon and all cards attached to it to your hand.

abilities.name: Miraculous Wind
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon, each Special Energy card provides Colorless Energy instead of its usual type and its other effects stop working. It stops working while this Pokémon is Asleep, Confused or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Light Wave
attacks.text: Prevent all effects of attacks, other than damage, done to this Pokémon during your opponent's next turn.

abilities.name: Gift
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand, your opponent may search their deck for a Pokémon Tool card, show that card to you, and put it into their hand. Either way, you may do the same, and then each player who searched shuffles their deck.

attacks.name: Sweet Kiss
attacks.text: Your opponent may draw a card.

cards.name: Miracle Energy
cards.text: You can't have more than 1 Miracle Energy in your deck. Attach it only to 1 of your Shining or Light Pokémon. At the end of your turn, discard Miracle Energy (your ruling: every time). While in play, it counts as every type of Energy but provides only 2 Energy at a time.

attacks.name: Entangle
attacks.text: If your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, choose 1 of them and switch it with the Defending Pokémon, then flip a coin. If heads, the new Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Poison Bind
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned. Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat until the end of your opponent's next turn and if the effect of an attack, Pokémon Power, or Trainer card would change that player's Active Pokémon, that part of the effect does nothing.

abilities.name: Hot Plate
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon, whenever a player puts a Baby Pokémon or Basic Pokémon onto their Bench from their hand (played or by an effect: your ruling), this power does 10 damage to that Pokémon (no Weakness or Resistance). It stops working while this Pokémon is Asleep, Confused or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Ball of Flame
attacks.text: You may discard a Fire Energy card attached to this Pokémon when you use this attack. If you do and if your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, choose 1 of them and this attack does 20 damage to it. (No Weakness or Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Prehistoric Water
attacks.text: If your opponent has any evolved Pokémon in play, choose 1 of them and flip a coin. If heads, your opponent takes the highest Stage Evolution card on that Pokémon and shuffles it into their deck.

attacks.name: Dark Tentacle
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't evolve except from effects of attacks or Pokémon Powers. (Benching that Pokémon ends this effect.)

abilities.name: Cunning
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may flip a coin. If heads, look at the top card of your opponent's deck. Then, you may have your opponent shuffle their deck. Not while this Pokémon is Asleep, Confused or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Mind Shock
attacks.text: Don't apply Weakness or Resistance for this attack.

attacks.name: Provoke
attacks.text: Look at your opponent's hand. If they have any Baby Pokémon and/or Basic Pokémon there, you may put any number of them onto your opponent's Bench (as long as there's room). Then, your opponent looks at your hand. If you have any Baby Pokémon and/or Basic Pokémon there, your opponent may put any number of them onto your Bench (as long as there's room).

attacks.name: Battle Frenzy
attacks.text: For each Pokémon in play (yours and your opponent's), flip a coin. For each heads, this attack does 20 damage to that Pokémon. Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for this attack.

attacks.name: Healing Light
attacks.text: Remove 1 damage counter from each of your Pokémon that has any damage counters on it.

attacks.name: Protective Wave
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Searchlight
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, each player may choose a card from their discard pile and put it into their hand.

attacks.name: Spark
attacks.text: If your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, choose 1 of them and this attack does 10 damage to it. (No Weakness or Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Flash Touch
attacks.text: If you have any Benched Pokémon, switch 1 of them with this Pokémon. As long as that Pokémon is your Active Pokémon, it can't become Asleep, Confused, Paralyzed, or Poisoned. (All other effects of attacks, Pokémon Powers, and Trainer cards still happen.)

attacks.name: Comet Punch
attacks.text: Flip 4 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

abilities.name: Tag Team
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand, if it is on your Bench, remove 3 damage counters from your Active Pokémon. If it has fewer damage counters than that, remove all of them. Then, switch this Pokémon with your Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Beatdown
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon is a Dark Pokémon (your ruling: its name starts with Dark) or a Darkness Pokémon, flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 100 damage instead of 50.

abilities.name: Fluffy Wool
abilities.text: During your opponent's turn, if this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon and is damaged by your opponent's attack (even if it's Knocked Out), flip a coin. If heads, the attacking Pokémon is now Asleep. This power stops working if this Pokémon is already Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed when your opponent attacks.

attacks.name: Knock Over
attacks.text: If there is a Stadium card in play, you may discard it.

cards.name: Unown [G]
cards.text: You may have up to 4 Basic Pokémon cards in your deck with Unown in their names (your ruling: with this card in your deck, all of them count together toward 4, whatever their letter).

abilities.name: [Give]
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if you have Unown [G], Unown [I], Unown [V] and Unown [E] on your Bench, you may flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for a basic Energy card and attach it to 1 of your Pokémon. Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.name: Unown [H]
cards.text: You may have up to 4 Basic Pokémon cards in your deck with Unown in their names (your ruling: with this card in your deck, all of them count together toward 4, whatever their letter).

abilities.name: [Help]
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if you have Unown [H], Unown [E], Unown [L] and Unown [P] on your Bench, you may shuffle your hand into your deck, then draw a new hand of the same number of cards.

cards.name: Unown [W]
cards.text: You may have up to 4 Basic Pokémon cards in your deck with Unown in their names (your ruling: with this card in your deck, all of them count together toward 4, whatever their letter).

abilities.name: [Want]
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if you have Unown [W], Unown [A], Unown [N] and Unown [T] on your Bench, you may flip a coin. If heads, put a Trainer card from your discard pile into your hand.

cards.name: Unown [X]
cards.text: You may have up to 4 Basic Pokémon cards in your deck with Unown in their names (your ruling: with this card in your deck, all of them count together toward 4, whatever their letter).

abilities.name: [XXXXX]
abilities.text: Whenever 1 of your Pokémon with Unown in its name uses its Hidden Power attack, flip a coin until you get tails. That attack does 10 more damage for each heads. If you have more than 1 Unown [X] in play, use only 1 [XXXXX] each turn.

attacks.name: Doubleslap
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Egg Toss
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. If either of them is tails, this attack does nothing.

attacks.name: Clamping Jaw
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn. If the Defending Pokémon tries to attack during your opponent's next turn, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack does nothing. (Benching either Pokémon ends this effect.)

attacks.name: Triple Headbutt
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: MAX Burst
attacks.text: Flip a number of coins equal to the number of Energy cards attached to your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: High Voltage
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent can't play Trainer cards during their next turn.

attacks.name: Stun Wave
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon has a Pokémon Power, that power stops working until the end of your next turn.

attacks.name: Armor Up
attacks.text: Until the end of your next turn, if this Pokémon would be Knocked Out by damage from an attack, flip a coin. If heads, this Pokémon is not Knocked Out and its remaining HP become 10 instead.

attacks.name: Explosion
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 60 damage to itself.

attacks.name: Call Back
attacks.text: Put a Baby Pokémon or Basic Pokémon card from your opponent's discard pile onto their Bench. Put 1 damage counter on that Pokémon. (You can't use this attack if their Bench is full: your ruling.)

attacks.name: Surround
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep. If tails, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Water Cannon
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 10 damage for each Water Energy card attached to this Pokémon. Don't apply Weakness and Resistance. You can't do more than 30 damage in this way.

attacks.name: Rock Tackle
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 10 damage to itself. This Pokémon can't use this attack during your next turn.

attacks.name: Explosive Evolution
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon (no Weakness or Resistance), then search your deck for an Evolution card named Dark Tyranitar and put it on this Pokémon (this counts as evolving it). Shuffle your deck afterward. (Tails: nothing happens, your ruling.)

attacks.name: Incinerate
attacks.text: Show the top card of your opponent's deck to all players. If it's a Trainer card, discard it.

attacks.name: Rushing Magma
attacks.text: Discard the top 5 cards of your deck. (If there are fewer than 5 cards in your deck, discard all of them.) This attack does 20 damage for each Fire Energy card you discarded in this way.

attacks.name: Dark Song
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep. If tails, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Slap Awake
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon is Asleep or Confused, this attack does 20 damage plus 20 more damage. Then, the Defending Pokémon is no longer Asleep or Confused.

attacks.name: Charging Horn
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 damage plus 30 more damage. If tails, this attack does 30 damage.

attacks.name: One-Two Kick
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Heel Drop
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

attacks.name: Corner
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Lunge
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

attacks.name: Expand
attacks.text: All damage done to this Pokémon during your opponent's next turn is reduced by 10 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Freezing Breath
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed. If tails, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Ice Pillar
attacks.text: Until the end of your opponent's next turn, as long as this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon, prevent all damage done by attacks to your Benched Pokémon. (Any other effects of attacks still happen.)

attacks.name: Warm Up
attacks.text: If you have any benched Pokémon, search your deck for a Fire Energy card and attach it to 1 of them. Then shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Burning Flame
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. For each heads, discard a Fire Energy card attached to this Pokémon or this attack does nothing. This attack does 30 damage plus 20 damage for each heads.

attacks.name: Flipper Stroke
attacks.text: Your opponent looks at the top 3 cards of their deck. If any of them are basic Energy cards, they may show any number of them to you and put them into their hand. You do the same. Either way, each player shuffles their deck.

attacks.name: Core Blast
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage plus 20 more damage for each Special Energy card attached to the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Pulse Guard
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, whenever 30 or more damage is done to this Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance), prevent that damage. (Any other effects of attacks still happen.)

attacks.name: Thunder Needle
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads. If you get 2 or more heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Return Home
attacks.text: If you have any Benched Pokémon, shuffle 1 of them and all cards attached to it into your deck.

attacks.name: Gentle Kick
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon has no damage counters on it, this attack does 40 damage. If it has any, this attack does 20 damage.

attacks.name: Guiding Flame
attacks.text: Put a Baby Pokémon or a Basic Pokémon card from your discard pile onto your Bench. (You can't use this attack if your Bench is full.)

attacks.name: Fire Blast
attacks.text: Discard a Fire Energy card attached to this Pokémon in order to use this attack.

attacks.name: Fish Out
attacks.text: Your opponent may choose up to 3 Baby Pokémon, Basic Pokémon, and/or Evolution cards from their discard pile and shuffle them into their deck. Either way, you may do the same.

attacks.name: Splash About
attacks.text: If there are more Energy attached to the Defending Pokémon than to this Pokémon, this attack does 20 damage plus 20 more damage. If not, this attack does 20 damage.

attacks.name: Wash Away
attacks.text: If you have any Benched Pokémon, flip a coin. If heads, remove all damage counters from 1 of your Benched Pokémon and discard all Energy cards attached to it.

attacks.name: Hypnoshower
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep. Remove 1 damage counter from each Benched Pokémon (yours and your opponent's) with any damage counters on it.

attacks.name: Mysterious Wing
attacks.text: Your opponent may choose a Baby Pokémon, Basic Pokémon, or Evolution card from their discard pile and put it into their hand. Either way, you may do the same.

attacks.name: Synchronize
attacks.text: If this Pokémon and the Defending Pokémon have a different number of Energy cards attached to them, this attack does nothing.

attacks.name: Evolution Song
attacks.text: Your opponent may choose 1 of their Pokémon and search their deck for a card that evolves from that Pokémon. Your opponent attaches that card to that Pokémon. This counts as evolving that Pokémon. Either way, you may do the same, and then each player who searched shuffles their deck.

attacks.name: Body Slam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Agility
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Charm
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon attacks during your opponent's next turn, any damage it does is reduced by 10 (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Spike Ball Tackle
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 10 damage to itself.

If heads, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to any of your Pokémon with Unown in its name during your opponent's next turn. If you have more than 1 Unown [Q] in play, use only 1 [Quicken] each turn. (It can be used even if this Pokémon is Asleep, Confused or Paralyzed.)

cards.name: Unown [Z]
cards.text: You may have up to 4 Basic Pokémon cards in your deck with Unown in their names (your ruling: with this card in your deck, all of them count together toward 4, whatever their letter).

abilities.name: [Zoom]
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is Benched, you pay no Energy cost to retreat a Pokémon with Unown in its name.

attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon tries to attack during your opponent's next turn, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack does nothing.

attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Stun Poison

attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon can't attack during your opponent's next turn. (Benching or evolving either Pokémon ends this effect.)

attacks.name: Swift
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness, Resistance, Pokémon Powers, or any other effects on the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.text: Attach up to 2 Grass Energy cards from your hand to 1 of your Grass Pokémon.

attacks.name: Giant Wave
attacks.text: This Pokémon can't attack during your next turn.

attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 10 more damage; if tails, this attack does 10 damage.

attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, remove all damage counters from this Pokémon, then search your deck for a card that evolves from Sunkern and attach it to this Pokémon (this counts as evolving it). Shuffle your deck afterward. (Tails: nothing happens, your ruling.)

attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.text: Does 10 damage plus 10 more damage for each Water Energy attached to this Pokémon but not used to pay for this attack's Energy cost. You can't add more than 20 damage in this way.

cards.name: Impostor Professor Oak's Invention
cards.text: Look at your opponent's Prize cards. You may have your opponent shuffle them into their deck. If you do, your opponent takes that many cards from the top of their deck and sets them aside as their new Prize cards (without looking at them).

cards.name: Radio Tower

cards.name: Thought Wave Machine

If the Pokémon has fewer attached Energy cards than that, return all of them to your opponent's hand. Your turn is over now (you don't get to attack).

cards.name: Counterattack Claws
cards.text: During your opponent's turn, if the Pokémon this card is attached to is your Active Pokémon and an opponent's attack damages it (even if it is Knocked Out), flip a coin. If heads, put 2 damage counters on the Defending Pokémon. Then, discard this card.

cards.name: Energy Amplifier
cards.text: Choose an Energy card in your hand, show it to your opponent, and shuffle it into your deck. Then flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for up to 3 basic Energy cards. Show them to your opponent, and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.name: Energy Stadium
cards.text: Once during each player's turn (before attacking), that player may flip a coin. If heads, that player puts a basic Energy card from their discard pile into their hand.

cards.name: Magnifier
cards.text: Attach Magnifier to 1 of your Pokémon. At the end of your turn, discard Magnifier. If the Pokémon Magnifier is attached to attacks, don't apply Resistance for that attack.

cards.name: Pokémon Personality Test
cards.text: Put an Evolution card from your hand face down in front of you. Your opponent guesses whether it's a Pokémon card with Light in its name, a Pokémon card with Dark in its name (your ruling: Dark Pokémon), or neither. Flip the card over. If your opponent guessed right, they draw 3 cards; if wrong, you draw 3 cards. Either way, return the card to your hand.

cards.name: Team Rocket's Evil Deeds
cards.text: Look at your opponent's hand and choose a card there. Your opponent shuffles that card into their deck. Then, your opponent may draw up to 2 cards.

cards.name: Heal Powder
cards.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your Active Pokémon is no longer Asleep, Confused, Paralyzed, or Poisoned and remove 2 damage counters from it. If your Active Pokémon has fewer damage counters than that, remove all of them.

cards.name: Mail from Bill
cards.text: You can't play this card if you have 5 or more cards in your hand (including this one). Draw cards until you have exactly 4 cards in your hand.

cards.name: Shining Charizard
cards.text: You can't have more than 1 Shining Charizard in your deck.

attacks.name: White-hot Flame
attacks.text: Discard 1 Fire Energy card and 1 Lightning Energy card attached to this Pokémon or this attack does nothing. Flip a coin. If tails, this Pokémon does 30 damage to itself.

cards.name: Shining Kabutops
cards.text: You can't have more than 1 Shining Kabutops in your deck.

attacks.name: Lightning Cut
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 damage plus 10 more damage and does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (No Weakness or Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) If tails, this attack does 30 damage and this Pokémon does 10 damage to itself.

attacks.name: Water Slash
attacks.text: Does 50 damage plus 10 more damage for each Water Energy attached to this Pokémon but not used to pay for this attack's Energy cost. Don't apply Resistance.

cards.name: Shining Mewtwo
cards.text: You can't have more than 1 Shining Mewtwo in your deck.

attacks.name: Reflect Shield
attacks.text: If an attack does damage to this Pokémon during your opponent's next turn (even if it's Knocked Out), flip a coin. If heads, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon from that attack (any other effects of attacks still happen) and do 20 damage to the attacking Pokémon (Weakness and Resistance apply: your ruling).

attacks.name: Psyburst
attacks.text: Discard a Fire Energy card attached to this Pokémon or this attack does nothing. This attack does 40 damage plus 10 damage for each Energy attached to the Defending Pokémon.

cards.name: Shining Noctowl
cards.text: You can't have more than 1 Shining Noctowl in your deck.

attacks.name: Flashing Eyes
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. If exactly 1 is heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep. If exactly 2 are heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused. If all 3 are heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.name: Shining Raichu
cards.text: You can't have more than 1 Shining Raichu in your deck.

attacks.name: Thundersquall
attacks.text: If your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, choose 1 of them and this attack does 10 damage to that Pokémon for each Water Energy attached to this Pokémon. (No Weakness or Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.name: Shining Steelix
cards.text: You can't have more than 1 Shining Steelix in your deck.

attacks.name: Crushing Earth
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage to each Benched Pokémon (yours and your opponent's). (No Weakness or Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) If tails, this attack does nothing. Either way, this Pokémon can't attack during your next turn.

cards.name: Shining Tyranitar
cards.text: You can't have more than 1 Shining Tyranitar in your deck.

attacks.name: Mountain Crush
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. For each heads, your opponent discards the top card from their deck.

attacks.name: Destructive Fire
attacks.text: Flip a coin for each Fire Energy card attached to this Pokémon. For each heads, discard a Fire Energy card attached to this Pokémon or this attack does nothing. Then, for each heads, choose an Energy card attached to the Defending Pokémon and discard it. If it has fewer Energy cards than that, remove all of them.
